messages:
maya: Thinking of a low-key after-work thing this Friday — 'Elm Cafe library vibes'? Quiet corner, soft music, board games optional. Who's in? :books: :coffee:
todd: Love that. What time were you thinking? 6pm works for me.
maya: 6pm sounds good. Plan is chill — BYO snacks, maybe 2 short trivia rounds and Codenames if people want. Not a loud party.
anita: I can bring cards + Codenames. Arriving ~6:30. Also will bring some gluten-free snacks and label them. :+1:
lee: @maya i'm on call til ~5:45 so i'll try to swing by for an hour after. Is Elm Cafe okay on transit? I might need to hop back if buses are slow. :shrug:
events-bot: Heads up — if you'd like the cafe corner reserved, create an /event in #lunch-plans so Facilities can confirm seating. Max capacity ~12 for that section.
maya: Good call, will make an event in a minute. Quick poll — react with :speech_balloon: for chill chat or :game_die: for boardgames-heavy.
todd: :game_die:
anita: :game_die:
lee: :speech_balloon:
maya: Games are winning but we'll keep it low-volume and cafe-friendly. RSVP pls so i can add headcount to the event. I'll post the calendar link & address once created.
todd: RSVP: yes — bringing a cheap travel Scrabble set.
anita: RSVP: yes — snacks + cards.
lee: RSVP: probably for 6:15-7:30 window. Might have to duck out but will join if i can.
maya: Awesome, thanks everyone — will post the event invite with address and a short code block of details in ~10min. See you Friday!

(maya posted event: /event Elm Cafe — Fri 6pm • corner table reserved • max 12 • bring snacks/games — link: https://calendar.redwood/evt/2735012345)
